div.div:
InputUnit (one instance per inport)
External wiring:
m_in_link NetworkLink ← upstream (flits in)
m_credit_link CreditLink → upstream (credits out)
virtualChannels[num_vcs]:
flitBuffer inputBuffer
m_vc_state (IDLE_ / VC_AB_ / ACTIVE_)
m_output_port, m_output_vc
creditQueue — outbound, drains to m_credit_link
wakeup():
read flit from m_in_link
virtualChannels[vc].insertFlit(f)
HEAD → route_compute → set m_outport
buffer (m_latency − 1) cycles
mark flit_stage = SA_
On SA-II grant (called by SwitchAllocator):
build Credit(vc, is_free_signal, now)
push onto creditQueue (→ upstream CreditLink)
TAIL / HEAD_TAIL → is_free_signal = true
Stats: m_num_buffer_writes / reads per-vnet

one per Router · no per-cycle state
outportCompute(route, inport, dirn)
TABLE_ : lookupRoutingTable(vnet, NetDest)
XY_ : outportComputeXY(row, col)
CUSTOM_: user-supplied
routing_table, weight_table
inports_dirn2idx, outports_dirn2idx[vnet]

div.font:
one per Router · runs every router cycle
wakeup():
SA-I arbitrate_inports():
each inport picks 1 VC (round-robin)
needs credit; HEAD needs free outvc
SA-II arbitrate_outports():
each outport picks 1 inport (round-robin)
vc_allocate(outport, inport, invc) for HEAD
OutputUnit::decrement_credit(outvc)
grant_switch(inport, flit) → CrossbarSwitch
enqueue Credit back to InputUnit.creditQueue
Max grants / cycle: ≤ min(num_inports, num_outports)
(one per inport in SA-I, one per outport in SA-II)
state: m_round_robin_invc[inport],
m_round_robin_inport[outport],
m_port_requests[], m_vc_winners[]

div.div:
OutputUnit (one instance per outport)
External wiring:
m_out_link NetworkLink → downstream (flits out)
m_credit_link CreditLink ← downstream (credits in)
flitBuffer outBuffer — flits waiting to enter m_out_link
outVcState[num_vcs]:
(IDLE_ / VC_AB_ / ACTIVE_)
m_credit_count — buffers free at downstream VC
has_free_vc(vnet), select_free_vc(vnet)
wakeup() (fires on credit arrival):
Credit c = m_credit_link.get()
increment_credit(c.vc)
if c.is_free_signal:
outVcState[c.vc] → IDLE_
re-schedule Router for stalled inports
On SA-II grant (called by SwitchAllocator):
decrement_credit(outvc)
CrossbarSwitch pushes flit to outBuffer
m_out_link drains it next cycle → stage LT_

div.font: switchBuffers[inport] (flitBuffer). wakeup(): drain each staged flit to OutputUnit.outBuffer — up to min(num_inports, num_outports) flits per cycle. Contention already resolved in SwitchAllocator one cycle earlier; this stage has no arbitration.

font.i: Credit flow is inter-router, not intra-router: each InputUnit sends credits upstream (left arrow above), each OutputUnit receives credits from downstream (right arrow above). Credits do not cross between IU and OU inside the same router.
